ground_truth_root_cause: Deploy sha=449ee7cc0d6e bumped github.com/IBM/sarama to v1.43.3. This version of sarama introduced a change in its TLS helper that, when Kafka TLS is enabled, globally overrides the process-wide TLS minimum and maximum version to TLS 1.3. The payment processor endpoint (payments.stripe-like.internal:443) only supports TLS 1.2. After the deploy, all outbound TLS connections to the payment processor failed with 'tls: no supported versions satisfy minVersion and maxVersion', causing 94%+ charge failures and triggering circuit breaker OPEN state.
ground_truth_remediation: Roll back payment-service to sha=a65d890990f0 (the previous deploy) using the standard deployment pipeline. This restores the prior sarama version and removes the TLS 1.3-only override, allowing TLS 1.2 handshakes with the payment processor to succeed. As a follow-up, pin github.com/IBM/sarama to a version that does not override global TLS settings, or add an explicit TLS config in payment-service/internal/tls/config.go that sets minVersion=TLS1.2 independently of sarama's initialization order.
